notes.claim: A smoothing capacitor turns the full-wave rippled output of the rectifier into smoother DC.
The DC-link capacitor is the energy reservoir and filter between rectifier and inverter.
A drive's DC bus after a three-phase bridge reads about 1.35 times the line-to-line voltage (a secondary source).
An uncharged capacitive circuit looks like a short circuit when line voltage is first applied, which is why drives charge the DC link through a limit.
Ripple voltage on a battery drives a ripple current that heats it and shortens its expected life.
